import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    L = np.log(eps)
    return (p[0] + p[1]*T**2*np.exp(-eps) + p[2]*L/(eps*T**2) + p[3]*T**6
            + p[4]*T**3/np.sqrt(eps) + p[5]*T**6*L**2 + p[6]*np.exp(T)
            + p[7]*np.exp(-eps)/T**2 + p[8]*T**4*eps + p[9]/(eps*T**2))
